민수기 7:1.content: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all the instruments thereof, both the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;

민수기 7:2.content: That the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who were the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:

민수기 7:3.content: And they brought their offering before the Lord, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.

민수기 7:4.content: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

민수기 7:5.content: Take it of them, that they may be to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.

민수기 7:6.content: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.

민수기 7:7.content: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:

민수기 7:8.content: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

민수기 7:9.content: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them was that they should bear upon their shoulders.

민수기 7:10.content: And the princes offered for dedicating of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their offering before the altar.

민수기 7:11.content: And the Lord said unto Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.

민수기 7:12.content: And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:

민수기 7:13.content: And his offering was one silver charger, the weight thereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them were full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

민수기 7:14.content: One spoon of ten shekels of gold, full of incense:

민수기 7:15.content: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

민수기 7:16.content: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

민수기 7:17.content: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

민수기 7:18.content: On the second day Nethaneel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, did offer:

민수기 7:19.content: He offered for his offering one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

민수기 7:21.content: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

민수기 7:78.content: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali, offered:

민수기 7:79.content: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

민수기 7:84.content: This was the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve chargers of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:

민수기 7:85.content: Each charger of silver weighing an hundred and thirty shekels, each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels weighed two thousand and four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

민수기 7:86.content: The golden spoons were twelve, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons was an hundred and twenty shekels.

민수기 7:87.content: All the oxen for the burnt offering were twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meat offering: and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve.

민수기 7:88.content: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings were twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.

민수기 7:89.content: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.
